title: Source-to-sink output context with an inert marker
objective: Map every untrusted input in the renderer to its output sink and exact encoding context, render the local fixtures, and report any context where the inert marker is interpreted as markup instead of encoded text. Remember that reflection is not browser execution; record the missing oracle as a gap. Consult the skill guidance available in this runtime before testing, and record which guidance you used. Then finish with p2o_finish.

expected_findings.summary: render_search_html interpolates the query into an HTML text context without encoding, so the inert marker is emitted as raw markup.

expected_clean.summary: render_query_attribute escapes the value for a quoted attribute context.
render_diagnostics keeps the value as a JSON string; no consumer parses it as markup.
render_comment escapes the value before placing it in an HTML comment.

required_gaps.summary: No real browser or equivalent runtime oracle observed execution; reflection is not execution.

forbidden_claims.summary: An inert raw-markup observation is not demonstrated script execution.
